archive.description: Raw observation (PSRFITS/filterbank folded by dspsr) or an already-folded archive

pulsar_name.description: Pulsar name (e.g. J0332+5454): the ephemeris is auto-exported from the catalogue for folding

ephemeris.description: Par file / par artifact ID to fold with (alternative to pulsar_name)

dm.description: Direct DM override for folding (alternative to pulsar_name/ephemeris)

fold.description: Run the dspsr folding step (false when the input is already a folded archive)

rfi_strategy.description: RFI handling: report only (scan), auto-zap the suspicious channels (zap), or skip (none)

build_standard.description: Build a standard-profile artifact from the reduced archive

measure.description: Measure profile metrics (S/N, width) on the reduced archive
